v056.title: v056 reference
v056.summary: Original photographs and original high-opacity colour/normal atlas.

A.title: A - Original scan, 25% overlay
A.summary: Only the existing overlay mask is reduced. Original 4K photo colours, photo normals, and v056 groove atlas remain unchanged.

B.title: B - Photo colour + v056 grooves
B.summary: Replace coarse overlay colour with the original 2m scanned soil. Keep the original v056 macro normal and overlay opacity.

C.title: C - Loamy scan + broken cultivation
C.summary: 3m clod scale, restrained normal-derived cavity shading, original scanned fine normals, and new broken lengthwise furrows. Matte surface; no diagonal tread stamps.

audit.previous_preview_problem: Fixed, large-world composite raster and mip selected before projection blurred near-camera detail.
audit.v057_control_problem: Changed photo normals and macro relief at the same time as reducing overlay opacity.
audit.shader_repeat_caution: Photo shader repetitions=0 was interpreted as inheritance by the old source preview. Native semantics are not proven; proposed full-version shaders will use explicit repeats.

B_C.strategy: Full-version design replaces existing 8K macro colour slot with a 4K photographic colour map; normal atlas remains 8K with independent 1x repeat. Integrate lower layer3 at matching colour repeats after selection.
B_C.caveat: Local render scope uses a sampler override; an isolated native test would require an extra masked pass. Full-track integration and native allocation validation are pending user selection.
